git add -A && git status --short | head -30 && git commit -m "feat(transport): answer list_conversations frames

Renames the frames this branch shipped as list_sessions/session_list to
the issue's list_conversations/conversation_list, and delivers them: the
store and a transport.history opt-in are threaded through createServer
into createMessageHandler, which answers the frame on the non-locked
path beside ping, calling listFor with ws.userId and both paging keys.

With the feature off, a store without listFor, or one refusing through
the new exported StoreCannotList, the answer is one UNSUPPORTED error
frame; any other listFor rejection is SERVER_ERROR with no store detail
on a socket left open, logged with the session id. The validator takes
an integer limit of 1-200 and an ISO-string two-half cursor. Test
helpers the suites shared move into wsTestSupport, the handler socket
is typed ExtWebSocket so the user id comes from the connection, and the
conversation-list spec's protocol section and the changelog entry
describe the shipped frames.

Refs re-cinq/HALEngine#144
